evidenceScope: Official platform research and reviewed safe published metadata only. No installed-client, old-GPT, migrated-plugin, or live-provider execution was performed.

platformContract.portableSchemaLimit: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 extension objects do not define app-mapping semantics; optional behavior requires the OpenAI-specific contract and eventual client testing.
platformContract.activation: Explicit skill selection and implicit matching are documented. Core tutoring need not call the backend. Explicit backend intent and an available arcanos_tutor tool are required by this package design.
platformContract.privateDistribution: Private local marketplace packaging is documented. Local installation does not prove web/mobile availability or workspace distribution. No installation, sharing, or migration is recorded here.
platformContract.surfaceLimit: Plugin skills are documented for eligible Chat/Work users on web, desktop and mobile. Desktop-only packages and account policies limit access. This does not certify the custom Tutor backend on mobile.

capabilities.proposedEquivalent: Use available host web search for current or source-grounded tutoring research.

surfaces.web: Documented subject to workspace restrictions; this package is untested.
surfaces.desktop: Documented host search; this package is untested.
surfaces.mobile: General plugin-skill availability is documented; this capability and account availability are not verified.

capabilities.explicitIntent: Use when the task asks for current facts, verification, or cited research; do not require search for ordinary self-contained tutoring.
capabilities.testMethod: After separate authorization, run explicit skill selection and a normal request for a current sourced explanation on each intended surface; inspect actual search activity, citation support, and the unavailable-tool response.
knownDifferences: The GPT capability switch does not transfer a guaranteed tool configuration.
Host search policy, availability and retrieved results can differ; no backend tool is required for this capability.

capabilities.proposedEquivalent: Use available host document/code editing, artifact previews, or interactive visualizations for editable learning material.

surfaces.web: Work file review is documented; visualizations require a supported account. Literal GPT Canvas equivalence is unverified.
surfaces.desktop: File previews and annotations are documented; visualization availability is in rollout. This package is untested.
surfaces.mobile: Visualization rollout depends on account/app version; literal Canvas editing and this package are unverified.

capabilities.explicitIntent: Use when the learner asks for an editable explanation, worksheet, code artifact, or interactive learning aid; do not claim Canvas was opened unless the host actually provides it.
capabilities.testMethod: After separate authorization, create a small editable lesson, revise one selected passage without changing another, and review the resulting artifact on each eligible surface; record any missing editor or preview as a difference.
knownDifferences: This is a proposed functional alternative, not proof of the original GPT Canvas UI, editing history, or session behavior.
Visualization rendering is not supported in Codex CLI or the IDE extension; those are not substitute proof for web/desktop/mobile.

capabilities.proposedEquivalent: Use available host image generation and image editing for requested learning illustrations.

surfaces.web: Image requests and reference-image input are documented; plan/workspace restrictions apply. This package is untested.
surfaces.desktop: Image creation, editing, and review are documented; this package is untested.
surfaces.mobile: General plugin-skill availability is documented; image execution with this package is unverified.

capabilities.explicitIntent: Require a request to create or edit an image before generating one; distinguish a proposed image from an actual generated result.
capabilities.testMethod: After separate authorization, request one educational illustration with verifiable labels and one specific revision; inspect actual image output, label accuracy, preservation requirements, and missing-tool behavior per intended surface.
knownDifferences: Available models, limits, image controls and output quality may differ from the original GPT.
A textual description or successful backend answer does not prove image-generation parity.

capabilities.proposedEquivalent: Use available host computation and file tools for requested calculations, supplied-data analysis, charts and exports.

surfaces.web: Work analysis and file creation are documented; exact execution tools and this package remain unverified.
surfaces.desktop: Work can use available local files and tools; exact computation environment and this package remain unverified.
surfaces.mobile: Continuing eligible cloud Work is documented; code execution and generated-file interaction for this package remain unverified.

capabilities.explicitIntent: Use for requested computation or analysis of supplied data, with an agreed output; do not claim code ran or a file was created without actual tool evidence.
capabilities.testMethod: After separate authorization, analyze a small synthetic dataset with known mean and total, produce a labeled chart and an export, independently check the arithmetic and artifact, and record the actual execution environment per intended surface.
knownDifferences: The original Code Interpreter environment, packages, persistence, execution limits and file lifecycle are not guaranteed.
Reasoned arithmetic alone is not evidence of code execution or file-generation parity; no backend tool is required for the proposed host workflow.
